# ssp_site_idps_config (Resource)

Manages the IDPS signature configuration for a specific onboarded site.

Corresponds to `GET/PUT/POST/DELETE /ssp/security-content/feature-config/idps/{site-id}`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auto_update` (Boolean) Whether this site automatically updates to the latest IDPS signature version.
- `site_id` (String) Unique identifier of the onboarded site (e.g. `ssp_site.example.id`) this configuration applies to.

### Optional

- `assigned_version` (String) IDPS signature version assigned to this site.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the site IDPS configuration, as returned by the API.
